RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly estimate a number from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth questioning as a process issue, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. The announcement also doesn’t provide enough information to compare your qualifications against the selection criteria.

Follow up in writing for the explanation, assessment criteria, your scores, and any available comparative reasoning. You can neutrally ask whether panel composition complied with applicable equality and recruitment rules.

Whether two weeks is overdue depends on your jurisdiction. Check complaint and appeal deadlines now; waiting for an explanation may not pause them. Stronger grounds for concern would include inconsistent criteria, sex-related comments, procedural departures, or unexplained differences in how candidates were assessed.
